answer.answer: The full form of PM POSHAN is Prime Minister's Overarching Scheme For Holistic Nourishment [E01]. Under this scheme, one hot cooked meal will be provided to children studying in Government and Government-aided schools [E01].

claim_to_evidence.claim: PM POSHAN stands for Prime Minister's Overarching Scheme For Holistic Nourishment
One hot cooked meal is provided to children studying in Government and Government-aided schools
